rationale: VERSION 2.0.1 -> 3.0.0 and pinned the canonical rule at 1ffa1234962c.; Replaced coupled and ineffective controls with one exact scene_profile axis recoverable from every returned grid.; Added a roughly 31% default linked public-profile prior covering all three training inputs and the held-out input, with translation and D4 orientation as nuisance variation.; Made canonical paired opposite-edge markers an explicit construction invariant and added vertical-only, horizontal-only, cross, multiple-line, adjacency-only, and edge-object lessons.; Added an exact semantic analyzer, override observer, strong self_check, independent Python rule mirror, deterministic construction, and focused regression tests.; Synchronized the grounded Racket source text exactly with the canonical and base authorities.
summary: Blue boundary markers select full rows and columns to paint blue. Every red connected object that intersects or is orthogonally adjacent to any selected row or column is recolored entirely blue; all other red objects remain red.
